label: Caller pushes for pricing — agent declines to quote
transcript:
Agent: Namaste, thank you for calling Aangan Studio. Before we begin, please note this call is recorded for quality and to help our designers. May I know your name?
Caller: Amit Kulkarni, from Kulkarni Associates.
Agent: Thank you, Amit. What kind of space are you looking at?
Caller: Our office in Kharadi, around 2200 square feet. But first tell me, what's your per square foot rate?
Agent: I understand you'd like a sense of cost. Pricing really depends on the site, materials and design, so I can't share a figure on the call. A designer will give you a proper estimate after understanding your space.
Caller: Just give me a ballpark, is it 1500 or 3000 per square foot?
Agent: I'm sorry, I'm not able to quote any numbers. What I can do is set up a consultation so a designer can share an estimate for your office. When are you planning to start?
Caller: Within two to three months. Budget is around 25 lakh.
Agent: Thank you. A designer from our team will call you back to arrange a consultation.
Caller: Okay, ask them to call after 4pm.
Agent: Noted. Thank you for calling Aangan Studio.
